title: Stamppot Stuffed Portobellos
description: A vegetarian take on traditional Dutch stamppot, this recipe features portobello mushrooms stuffed with a savory mixture of sautéed lardons and herbs, served with a side of creamy stamppot.
instructions: 2. Clean and prepare the portobello mushrooms by removing the stems and gills.
3. In a pan over medium heat, cook the lardons until crispy. Set aside.
4. In the same pan, add the stamppot and cook until heated through.
5. In a separate pan, combine the cooked lardons, stamppot, and sour sauce. Stir until well combined.
6. Stuff each portobello mushroom cap with the lardon mixture.
7. Drizzle the molten sauce over the stuffed mushrooms, if using.
8. Bake the mushrooms in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until tender.
9. Serve the stuffed mushrooms with a side of the stamppot mixture.
